idea-plugin.name: Hex Swatch
idea-plugin.description:
Shows a small colour mark before every colour in any file: CSS, Blade, HTML, JS, PHP, Vue, Markdown. Click the mark to change the colour.

  • Hex colours (#abc, #aabbcc, #aabbccaa) get a circle. Click it for PhpStorm's colour picker, with opacity. The hex in the code updates as you drag. This also works inside Tailwind classes like hover:bg-[#a10000]/50.
  • rgb() and rgba() (rgb(255, 0, 0), rgba(0,128,255,.5), rgb(255 0 0 / 50%)) also get a circle and the same picker. The new colour is written in the same style: commas or spaces, and a percentage opacity stays a percentage.
  • hsl(), hsla() and oklch() (hsl(0 100% 50%), hsla(210, 50%, 40%, .8), oklch(63.7% 0.237 25.331)) get a circle too, written back in the same format and style.
  • Tailwind colour classes (border-red-600, hover:text-sky-300/50) get a diamond. Click it for a row of that colour's shades, 50 to 950. Pick one and only the shade number changes. Under the shades is every Tailwind colour at the current shade: pick one and only the colour name changes (bg-red-500 → bg-blue-500). The last row sets the opacity (bg-red-500 → bg-red-500/30; 100 makes it solid again).
  • Tailwind white and black (text-white, bg-black/50) also get a diamond. Click it for every colour at 500, plus white and black, and the opacity row.
  • Tailwind sizes (off by default): click a size class like p-4, -mt-2, w-12, text-lg, rounded-md or shadow-sm for a row of sizes. Only the size changes. Turn it on in Settings → Tools → Hex Swatch.

Notes:

  • Marks show next to PhpStorm's own gutter swatches; the plugin changes no IDE settings.
  • The text is scanned 300 ms after you stop typing. Files over 2 MB are skipped.
  • Tailwind colours follow the project's Tailwind version: 3 if Tailwind 3 is installed or listed in package.json, otherwise 4. Custom theme colours are not read.
  • Words made only of a–f (like #add) can look like colours and get a circle.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.8.0

  • New: an opacity row at the bottom of the Tailwind diamond popup (5 to 100, over a checkerboard). Pick one and only the /50 part changes; 100 removes it (bg-red-500/50 → bg-red-500).

1.7.0

  • New: the Tailwind diamond popup also shows every Tailwind colour at the current shade. Pick one and only the colour name changes (hover:bg-red-500/50 → hover:bg-blue-500/50). Hover a colour for its name.
  • White and black are in the same row: bg-red-500 → bg-white, and bg-white → bg-red-500.

1.6.0

  • New, off by default: click a Tailwind size class like p-4, w-12, text-lg or rounded-md for a row of sizes; pick one and only the size changes (hover:px-4 → hover:px-6).
  • Turn it on in Settings → Tools → Hex Swatch: spacing (padding, margin, gap, space), width/height, and text size/rounded/shadow.

1.5.0

  • New: hsl(), hsla() and oklch() colours get a circle and the colour picker (the format Tailwind 4 and shadcn/ui use). The picked colour is written back in the same format and style.

1.4.1

  • The Tailwind shade row and white/black popup open just below the clicked line, or just above it near the bottom of the screen, so they never cover the colour being changed.

1.4.0

  • New: rgb() and rgba() colours get a circle and the colour picker, in comma, space and / alpha styles (and Tailwind's rgb(255_0_0)). The picked colour is written back in the same style.

1.3.0

  • New: text-white, bg-black and the other white/black classes get a diamond; click it to swap between white and black. Variants and /50 opacity are kept.

1.2.0

  • Tailwind 4 colours, including the new mauve, olive, mist and taupe. Each project uses the colours of its own Tailwind version (3 or 4).
  • Works in all JetBrains IDEs from 2023.3 on.
  • Plugin icon.

1.1.0

  • New: Tailwind colour classes (bg-, text-, border-, ring-, fill- and others) get a diamond; click it to pick a shade from 50 to 950.
  • Opacity suffixes like /50 show as see-through.
  • Hex colours now get a circle instead of a square, so they look different from PhpStorm's own swatches.

1.0.0

  • First version: a square before every hex colour in any file; click it for a colour picker.
